newsitem.title: USA: New $50 million hangar complex at Newark airport.
newsitem.headline: New $50 million hangar complex at Newark airport.

text.p: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey has approved a $50 million hangar complex at Newark International airport in response to growing overseas flights.

The 78,000 sq.ft hangar is scheduled to open in October and as part of the project, Continental Airlines is to employ an extra 100 technical operation staff surpassing Houston and making Newark the largest in its syste.

In addition, the Port Authority approved a $43 million British Airways parking garage and a road improvement project at John. F. Kennedy International airport. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
